calendar: Every original in-year minute, all CORE5 symbols; no prior-year minute warmup added
admission: Reuse exact519b17f6 inherited_input_binding.verify_source and check_file/schema, original INPUT_BINDINGS and source-index/month hashes. No native financial port, Polars wrapper, account, target or holdings import.
original_window: Unchanged rolling intraday30days with original READY/reason masks; 2024 original10 derived mark cells and contaminated windows retained
controls: Legacy-independent versus aligned-independent isolates endpoint-population effect; aligned-independent versus paired isolates coupling. Six normalized equity-hurdle arrays, unchanged formula and costs.
causal_checks: For each symbol fixed source-array cuts min(N,43200+1440), floor(N/2), max(1,N-1440). Compare every feature against standalone prefix and full arrays with only later marks/opens/clocks/derived masks perturbed.
evidence: Full-calendar and every complete-day readiness/reason counts, coefficient statistics, exact difference counts and signed values, fixed absolute-delta quantiles50/95/99, array hashes and exact lossless state-run archives. Preserve READY float bits including signed zero; NOT_READY NaN is missing, never a zero hurdle.
no_threshold_selection: No fitted parameters, search, economic cutoff, trigger epsilon, source-date selection or scenario truncation. Tiny float differences remain explicit and do not imply profitable or safety-relevant changes.
decision_use: If ready coefficients are observationally identical, retain that result and stop rather than inventing a difference. Otherwise report direction, magnitude and frequency for review; coefficient difference alone does not certify owned-state trigger changes or grant wallet GO.
fail_closed: Reject code/index/month/schema/derived coordinates mismatch, causal failure, nonfinite READY coefficient, authorization/resource failure or output cap. Preserve explicit attempt logs and partial artifacts; no automatic retry, overwrite, resume, repair or scenario dropping.
risk_interpretation: Independent maxima are a conservative assumption, not an established bug. Joint observed scenarios can miss unseen simultaneous extremes; no unconditional dominance, false-positive, PnL or safety claim.
